candidates.name: LLM_AckOnlyForMovedMachines
candidates.rationale: A Machine is added to AcknowledgedMove only after its OwnerRef is flipped to newMS (machineset_controller.go:381).

candidates.name: LLM_DoneImpliesOnNewMs
candidates.rationale: Ownership flip precedes completion; an InPlaceDone Machine must be on newMS.

candidates.name: LLM_OnOldMsImpliesNoAck
candidates.rationale: OnOldMS is the pre-handshake phase; the AcknowledgedMove set has no entry for it.

candidates.name: LLM_DoneNoHookPending
candidates.rationale: Contrapositive of UpdateMachineHookShape, completing the partition.

candidates.name: LLM_OldMsImpliesAtOldVersion
candidates.quint_body:
MACHINES.forall(m =>
  machinePhase.get(m) == OnOldMS implies machineVersion.get(m) == oldMsVersion)
candidates.rationale: Version flip happens during CompleteInPlaceUpdate; OnOldMS Machines retain oldMsVersion.

candidates.name: LLM_NoInProgressOnOldMs
candidates.quint_body:
MACHINES.forall(m =>
  machinePhase.get(m) == OnOldMS implies (not(machineInProgress.get(m)) and not(infraInProgress.get(m)) and not(bootstrapInProgress.get(m))))
candidates.rationale: Cleanup clears the trio before returning to OnOldMS; no transition adds it from OnOldMS.
